items.title: Ground states beyond the small static perturbation regime
items.detail: The small static regime is now covered qualitatively. Construct compatible vacua and useful spectral estimates beyond it; local dynamics alone is insufficient.

items.title: Moment constraints on interacting loop observables
items.detail: First verify exact factorization of the ordinary two-square Euclidean Wilson measure. A nonfactorized test requires a declared mixed-loop deformation or a higher-dimensional complex; shared-link Hamiltonian kinetics do not supply this Euclidean coupling.

items.title: Controlled removal of a deformation
items.detail: Declare changed action and geometry, then prove a controlled removal/equivalence limit. Absence of a phase transition is not an available premise.

items.title: Four-dimensional construction and physical gap
items.detail: Nontrivial continuum construction, scale matching, reconstruction axioms and positive finite physical spectral threshold remain missing. The current stability domain is exited by g_H->0.
